name: noteflow
description: NoteFlow - a full-stack notes application (Node.js + React) built for the 10Pearls Shine program.
author: Muhammad Saim Ayyaz

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p scripts
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage -w server && npm run test:coverage -w client
